scripts.hook: I tried this for 30 days and my mornings completely changed
scripts.body: [Pattern interrupt: zoom to journal] Here's the thing — I didn't add MORE to my morning. I actually removed everything except three things. [Cut to walking shot] Five minutes of journaling, a 10-minute walk, and water before coffee. [Pattern interrupt: text overlay with stats] After 30 days, my sleep score went from 62 to 78. [Cut back to face] But the real change? I actually WANT to wake up now.
scripts.cta: Follow for more wellness tips that don't require waking up at 4am
scripts.visualDirections: Open on face close-up, warm morning light. Cut to overhead shot of journal writing. Transition to outdoor walking shot with natural light. Cut to side-by-side comparison graphic. End on face shot with genuine smile.

scripts.hook: 3 things nobody tells you about building healthy habits
scripts.body: [Cut to list format with text] Number one — you don't need to wake up earlier. Just use the time you're already wasting on your phone. [Pattern interrupt: screen recording of phone usage stats] Number two — tracking your mood is more important than tracking your steps. [Cut to mood tracker app] Number three — the hardest part isn't starting, it's week three. [Pattern interrupt: calendar animation] That's when motivation dies and discipline hasn't formed yet.
scripts.cta: Save this for when you need a reminder. Link in bio for the full guide.
scripts.visualDirections: Open with bold text on dark background. Transition to split-screen showing phone usage stats. Middle section: app demo footage. End with motivational calendar graphic. Clean, high-contrast visuals throughout.

captions.captionText: Morning routine that actually works — no 4am alarm needed 🌅
Healthy habits nobody tells you about — especially #3 😳

videoPrompts.veo3Prompt: A young professional in their late 20s sits on a bed in a bright, modern bedroom with natural morning sunlight streaming through sheer curtains. Warm amber color grading, shallow depth of field. Camera starts in close-up on face, then cuts to overhead shot of hands writing in a leather journal on a wooden desk. Transition to outdoor walking shot on a tree-lined street, golden hour lighting, handheld camera feel. Cut to side-by-side infographic showing before/after sleep scores. End on medium shot of person smiling genuinely at camera. 30 seconds, 5 scene transitions. Lo-fi hip hop background music at low volume.

Bold white text on a dark navy background, clean sans-serif font. Quick animated transitions between numbered list items. Cut to screen recording of phone showing screen time stats (7h 23m). Transition to close-up of a wellness tracking app on a phone screen. Calendar animation showing days being checked off, pausing at day 21 with a red highlight. Clean editorial style, high contrast, vibrant accent colors on dark backgrounds. 30 seconds, 6 scene changes. Upbeat electronic background music.
